title: Generative Action-Chunk Sampling for Adaptive Stiffness Control in Physical Human-Robot Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2608.25284v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical human-robot collaboration requires a robot to provide assistance when human intention is clear while remaining compliant when several future motions are plausible. We present an adaptive stiffness framework based on generative action-chunk sampling. Conditioned on an RGB image and external joint-torque estimates, the policy samples multiple future action chunks from an observation-conditioned prior. Variation among the sampled action chunks is used to continuously adapt joint stiffness and damping. Greater variation makes the robot more compliant to facilitate human guidance, whereas lower variation provides firmer assistance. In a real-world collaborative transport task with four possible directions, the proposed method achieved an average success rate of 0.95, compared with 0.83 for a fixed-stiffness ablation and 0.69 for a deterministic baseline. translated_title: 生成式动作块采样在物理人机协作中的自适应刚度控制
translated_abstract: 物理人机协作要求机器人在人类意图明确时提供辅助，而在多种未来动作可能时保持顺从性。我们提出了一种基于生成式动作块采样的自适应刚度框架。该策略以RGB图像和外部关节扭矩估计为条件，从观测条件先验中采样多个未来动作块。采样动作块之间的变异性用于连续调整关节刚度和阻尼。变异性较大时，机器人更顺从以促进人类引导，而变异性较小时则提供更坚定的辅助。在具有四种可能方向的真实世界协作运输任务中，所提方法实现了平均成功率0.95，而固定刚度消融为0.83，确定性基线为0.69。在方向确定附近，采样动作块之间的变异性增加。
tldr: 通过采样未来动作块并利用其变异性动态调整机器人刚度，实现了在意图明确时提供辅助、在意图模糊时保持顺从的自适应协作控制，显著提升了任务成功率。
en_tdlr: By sampling future action chunks and leveraging their variation to dynamically adjust robot stiffness, this method enables adaptive assistance when intent is clear and compliance when ambiguous, markedly improving task success rates.
